description:
Talli is a companion app for British Columbia income and disability assistance recipients. It connects to your existing BC Self-Serve account and surfaces the information that matters most, without the slow, confusing government portal.

FEATURES
• Dashboard: next payment amount, countdown, and payment history at a glance
• Payment calendar: see past and upcoming deposit dates
• Monthly report tracking: know when your reporting window is open and whether you've filed
• PWD (Persons with Disabilities) application status timeline
• RDSP and Canada Disability Benefit (CDB) tracking
• Benefits guide: grocery rebate, GST/HST credit, climate action credit, Canada Workers Benefit, BC Bus Pass,
and more
• Secure sign-in with your existing BCeID/BC Self-Serve credentials, biometric unlock supported
• Offline caching for instant launch
• CSV export of your payment history

Talli does not replace BC Self-Serve. It reads your existing account data to save you the trip through the
government portal. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Government of British Columbia.
whatsNew:
Messages stay fresh now. New ones show up when you open the app.

Turn the payday reminder and the report-window reminder on or off, one at a time, in Settings.

Your widget shows your monthly income, on iPhone and Mac.

Home is simpler. One payday, one countdown, nothing extra.
